mapper.sql: id, company_id, position_name, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.company_id, p.position_name, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, c.company_name AS companyName FROM org_position p LEFT JOIN org_company c ON c.id = p.company_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_employee WHERE position_id = #{positionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO org_position (company_id, position_name, status) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{positionName}, #{status})
